_comment: Generated by app/dev/extract_message_codes.py from src/kikitori/hardware/messages.py CATALOG; do not edit by hand.

asr_gpu.english: {gpu_name} ({vram_mb} MiB VRAM): {fast_model} for live subtitles, {final_model} for final subtitles ({compute_type})

asr_gpu_int8_saves_vram.english: int8_float16 halves the VRAM used by speech recognition, leaving more for the translation model

asr_final_no_speech_unreliable.english: {final_model} cannot tell speech from silence (no_speech); {fast_model}'s no_speech and the voice detector filter non-speech instead

asr_large_v3_remote_translation.english: Translation does not run on this computer, so final subtitles use {final_model} (similar quality, reliable no_speech, about 0.33 s per sentence)

asr_apple_silicon.english: Apple Silicon: speech recognition runs on the CPU on macOS; {fast_model} for live subtitles, {final_model} for final subtitles

asr_apple_silicon_untested.english: Apple Silicon latency has not been measured yet; using the same models as a CPU with 16 GB of RAM or more

asr_cpu.english: Speech recognition runs on the CPU (16 GB of RAM or more): {fast_model} for live subtitles, {final_model} for final subtitles

asr_cpu_large_models_slow.english: medium and larger models need 3.6 s or more per sentence on a CPU, too slow for live subtitles

asr_cpu_low.english: Lightweight models keep latency and memory low: {fast_model} for live subtitles, {final_model} for final subtitles

cpu_low_ram.english: {ram_gb:.1f} GB of RAM is less than 16 GB

multiple_gpus.english: {gpu_count} NVIDIA GPUs found; using {gpu_name}, the one with the most VRAM

cuda_platform_unsupported.english: CTranslate2 has no CUDA build for this platform (Windows and Linux x86-64 only); speech recognition uses the CPU

cuda_driver_too_old.english: NVIDIA driver {driver_version} is too old (CUDA 12 needs {min_driver} or newer); speech recognition uses the CPU until the driver is updated

cuda_compute_capability_unknown.english: Cannot read the GPU's compute capability (the driver may be too old); speech recognition uses the CPU

cuda_compute_capability_unsupported.english: {gpu_name} (compute capability {compute_capability}) does not support CTranslate2's float16/int8 acceleration; speech recognition uses the CPU

gpu_runtime_missing.english: cuBLAS is not installed: GPU acceleration needs the GPU runtime download (about 570 MB); until then speech recognition uses the CPU

asr_vram_insufficient.english: Not enough VRAM for the speech recognition models (about {need_mb} MiB needed); speech recognition uses the CPU

memory_unknown.english: Cannot read the amount of memory; using the lightest speech recognition models

asr_language_quality_low.english: {model} recognizes {language} poorly (error rate above 20% on public benchmarks)

translation_remote.english: The translation server is not on this computer ({base_url}); choose one of its models in Settings

translation_cpu.english: No usable GPU: the translation model runs on the CPU, so the smallest model is chosen (CPU speed not measured)

translation_budget_vram.english: About {budget_gb:.1f} GB of VRAM is left for the translation model after speech recognition and a 1 GB reserve

translation_budget_unified.english: About {budget_gb:.1f} GB of unified memory is left for the translation model after speech recognition and the system reserve

translation_same_model.english: Live and final translation use the same model: each sentence takes under 0.3 s on a GPU, while switching models in Ollama takes 1.5-18 s

translation_different_models.english: Live and final translation use different models

translation_better_model_available.english: Chose {model} from the installed models; installing {better_model} gives better quality

translation_not_needed.english: {source_language} and {target_language} are the same spoken language: no translation model is needed, only script conversion

source_language_auto.english: The listening language is detected automatically: the translation model is chosen to translate any language into {target_language}

translation_server_unreachable.english: Cannot connect to the translation server {base_url} (is Ollama running?); installed models cannot be checked

translation_model_list_unavailable.english: Cannot get the translation server's model list: {error}

low_ram_for_translation.english: Less than 8 GB of RAM: running the translation model and speech recognition together may not fit

translation_model_not_installed.english: The recommended translation model {model} is not installed yet

translation_model_exceeds_budget.english: {model} needs about {model_gb:.1f} GB, more than the {budget_gb:.1f} GB available; Ollama will run part of it on the CPU, which is slower

combination_not_object.english: The model combination must be an object

asr_device_invalid.english: {path}: device must be auto, cpu or cuda

asr_compute_type_not_string.english: {path}: compute_type must be a string or null

asr_cpu_threads_invalid.english: {path}: cpu_threads must be an integer from 0 to 256

asr_cuda_no_gpu.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but no NVIDIA GPU was found

asr_cuda_platform_unsupported.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but CTranslate2 has no CUDA build for this platform (Windows and Linux x86-64 only)

asr_cuda_driver_too_old.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but NVIDIA driver {driver_version} is too old (CUDA 12 needs {min_driver} or newer)

asr_cuda_compute_capability_unknown.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but the GPU's compute capability is unknown (the driver may be too old)

asr_cuda_compute_capability_unsupported.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but {gpu_name} (compute capability {compute_capability}) does not support CTranslate2's float16/int8 acceleration

asr_cuda_cublas_missing.english: {path}: CUDA is selected but cuBLAS is not installed; download the GPU runtime first

translation_model_name_invalid.english: {field} must be a model name of 1-{max_chars} characters or null

asr_auto_uses_cpu.english: {path}: auto will use the CPU (the GPU cannot run speech recognition now)

asr_compute_type_cpu_fallback.english: {path}: the CPU does not support {compute_type}; CTranslate2 will use another type (usually float32, slower)

asr_compute_type_gpu_fallback.english: {path}: compute capability {compute_capability} does not support {compute_type}; CTranslate2 will use float32 or int8_float32 (slower, more VRAM)

asr_model_slow_on_cpu.english: {path}: {model} needs 3.6 s or more per sentence on a CPU; subtitles will lag noticeably

asr_model_not_downloaded.english: {path}: speech recognition model {model} is not downloaded yet; it is downloaded before starting

asr_fast_larger_than_final.english: The live model {fast_model} is larger than the final model {final_model}: live subtitles may be slower than final ones

asr_no_speech_unavailable.english: Neither {fast_model} nor {final_model} can filter non-speech with no_speech; singing and noise are more likely to be transcribed

translation_model_not_on_server.english: The translation server does not have {model}

translation_license_non_commercial.english: The license of {model} ({license}) forbids commercial use

translation_license_region_restricted.english: The license of {model} ({license}) does not apply in {regions}

translation_models_differ.english: Live and final translation use different models: the local Ollama takes 1.5-18 s each time it switches models

vram_overflow.english: Speech recognition and translation need about {need_mb} MiB of VRAM, more than the {available_mb} MiB available on {gpu_name}; they may be slow or fail to load

asr_ram_over_half.english: The speech recognition models on the CPU use more than half of the RAM

translation_disabled.english: Translation is off: only the original text is shown and no translation model is needed
